₹500 a month. Can it really make you a crorepati? 🤔

Year 10: ₹60K in, ~₹1.16L
Year 30: ₹1.8L in, ~₹17.6L
₹1 crore: ~44 years
Raise it 10% every year: ~36 years, about 8 years sooner.

Start with ₹500. Just don't stay at ₹500. Save this for your next SIP review.

When will you step up your SIP? 👇

Figures assume 12% a year for illustration; real returns vary and nothing is guaranteed.
